name: b200-like
description: B200-like accelerator for the panel serving experiments. Roofline from published NVIDIA Blackwell B200 datasheet figures (dense BF16 tensor throughput 2.25 PFLOPS, HBM3e 8 TB/s, 180 GB). No measurement behind these timings; every profile synthesized from this spec is labelled analytically_estimated and the label is printed with the numbers. Not the port-budget study's 'b200' row (that was a four-port 200 GiB/s link budget).

compute.model: time = max(flops / (peak * achieved_fraction), bytes / hbm_bandwidth) + kernel_floor

dma.notes: no separate DMA model in G4; memory-pool transfers are network flows (G5)

notes: 180 GB = 167.6 GiB. achieved_fraction and kernel_floor_us are stated assumptions of the roofline, swept in G7 sensitivity, never presented as measurements.
